descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P1 · our extension of a stated behaviour · ours: data volume (12 × 4 tasks).

Approach · TC-07 Task Export · S20 Full census: 12 patients × 4 tasks per context — everything present and grouped; time to open and copy recorded

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 One consolidated in-app end-of-day view lists every open task across all of the physician's patients, each attributed to its patient (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U2 On the view the list is grouped by patient, pending tasks first and completed tasks at the bottom; every task shows which patient it belongs to (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U3 Copy Text copies the whole list (pending and completed) to the clipboard in the same grouping, every task under its patient; the copy stays on the device (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U10 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home (UAT TC-07; UAT 3.3; TFA-92585 AC 12) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • G3 UAT 3.4 applied to the list: the view, Copy Text and the sent list contain only stored tasks, patients and locations — no invented task, patient, room, 'undefined' or 'null' (UAT 3.4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr

Test design technique: Performance (performance) — Measure the time and check it is within the required seconds.

Given 12 seeded Hospital patients and 12 Nursing Home residents on Today's Visits, 4 open tasks each

When Open each Task Export (time from tap to all tasks shown), scroll to the end, tap Copy Text (time to 'copied')

Then All 48 tasks per context appear once, each under its own patient, in the view and in the copy; both times recorded

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Correctness judged (every seeded task present once and groupedUnder its patient, nothing else: G3). Timings recorded for a human, no target (Q11). Without the seed the screen reads 'No tasks yet' and, with only url and mustNotContain evaluated, would pass

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S20 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-07.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: PERF · Performance timing — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.
